parameters.name: button_2_x

parameters.name: plunger_head_diameter

parameters.name: plunger_length

parameters.name: case_width
parameters.label: Case width
parameters.expression: max(pcb_width + pcb_clearance * 2, battery_width + battery_clearance * 2, display_width + display_clearance * 2, speaker_width + speaker_clearance * 2) + wall * 2
parameters.description: Calculated outside case width from the largest internal component footprint.

parameters.name: case_height
parameters.label: Case height
parameters.expression: max(pcb_height + pcb_clearance * 2, battery_height + battery_clearance * 2, display_height + display_clearance * 2, speaker_height + speaker_clearance * 2) + wall * 2
parameters.description: Calculated outside case height from the largest internal component footprint.

parameters.name: case_depth
parameters.label: Case depth
parameters.expression: front_wall + display_thickness + clearance + pcb_assembled_height + clearance + battery_thickness + lid_lip_depth + lid_depth
parameters.description: Calculated case depth: front wall, display, PCB (assembled), battery, then the lid lip and lid. Buttons and SD card sit on the PCB and don't add depth; the speaker sits beside the PCB, not in the stack.
